name: Audiobook Library
description: Plays audiobooks in a chapter-aware player styled after Audiobookshelf's. The now-playing bar shows chapter marks and the current chapter, with chapter skip, 10-second skips, speed and a chapter list. On phones, tapping the bar opens a full-page player. Playback speed is remembered for each book and each user.
overview: Chapter-aware audiobook player for Jellyfin's web client and apps

versions.changelog: Adds safe chapter writing for M4B files. Chapters go into a copy without re-encoding, the copy is checked against the original (same audio, length and tags) before replacing it, and the original is kept as a .bak that can be restored. Nothing uses it yet; the admin page arrives in the next release.

Adds silence detection for books without chapters. The server scans a file with Jellyfin's own ffmpeg in the background and suggests chapter breaks from long pauses. Nothing uses it yet; the admin page for reviewing and applying chapters arrives in a later release.

Adds a server-side lookup of Audible book details, chapters and author bios through Audnexus, saved on the server so each book is fetched about once a month. Nothing uses it yet; the admin page for matching books arrives in a later release.

First stable release of the chapter-aware player. Audiobooks get their own now-playing bar styled after Audiobookshelf's, with chapter marks, previous and next chapter, 10-second skips, speed and a chapter list. On phones, tapping the bar opens a full-page player. Chapters work across split M4B and multi-file MP3 books, and stopping keeps your place in Continue Listening. New since 0.1.4.2: playback speed is remembered for each book and each user.
Fixed: the Android app's back button now closes the full-page player instead of going back a page underneath it.
Fixed: the phone's back button now closes the full-page player and its popups instead of leaving the app.

Audiobooks get their own now-playing bar in place of Jellyfin's, styled after Audiobookshelf. On phones, tapping the bar opens a full-page player. Speed and chapter popups are no longer covered by the bar.
Chapter-aware full-screen player with chapter marks, previous and next chapter, 10-second skips, speed and a chapter list.
Added a chapters API that puts a book's chapters on one timeline, including split M4B and multi-file MP3 books.
Fixed: stopping playback saved position 0 and removed the book from Continue Listening.
Audiobooks open in the plugin's own player instead of Jellyfin's. Early test version.
Plugin skeleton with an empty dashboard page.
